description: INSEED, the statistics institute of the Union of the Comoros, ran the fourth General Population and Housing Census (RGPH 2017) between December 2017 and January 2018 and publishes its analysis reports and questionnaires on its national microdata archive. The theme 2 report on households and housing has a chapter on dwellings with percent tables by island (Mwali, Ndzuwani, Ngazidja) and by urban or rural area. It covers rooms occupied, wall and roof materials, drinking water source, main lighting, cooking energy, toilets and disposal of waste and wastewater. The report states that 76.2 percent of households used electricity for lighting, 8.7 percent a kerosene lamp and 5.6 percent solar power, and that 47.5 percent of dwellings had hard or cement walls and 40.5 percent corrugated sheet walls. Coverage is national. Format and access: free PDF reports in French; the census microdata, down to enumeration area, are listed as licensed files. Licence: not stated for the reports. Caveats: report tables are percentages; the old inseed.km site is under maintenance and the institute now uses inseed-comores.org. Simulation uses: building material and electrification by island for cyclone exposure and energy access planning. Related records: IPUMS International and the WorldPop population grid.
